description: Implementation of the DigitalProductService interface managing digital product files, including adding, retrieving, deleting, and updating digital products within the shop management system.

classes.name: DigitalProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class providing implementations for managing digital products, including file handling and updates within the e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates a digital file with a product, uploads the file, and updates the product status to virtual.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the digital product info for a specific product within a merchant store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the digital product and associated file, and resets the product to non-virtual.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a digital product and marks the associated product as virtual.
